notes.cut_order: T4 question-bank, T11 free-form, T9 risk beat, T8 artifact polish; never isolation, process separation, or memory-only opener

items.title: Verify the installed Hermes contract
items.goal: Replace every provisional Hermes path and capability assumption with verified, fallback, or unsupported evidence.
items.scope: Sprint 1 task 1 only: read-only discovery plus preflight artifacts. Do not implement weakness merge, demo sessions, or isolation enforcement beyond recording the chosen Curator strategy.
items.description: Read-only discovery first. Record findings in docs/hermes-compatibility.md and replace provisional paths/commands with shared variables in scripts/demo_common.sh. Also record: who writes MEMORY.md (agent-direct vs Hermes-mediated) and whether a delimited YAML section survives a write round-trip. Pick one Curator strategy. Test first: failing preflight that checks Hermes executable/version; effective MEMORY.md and skill-dir paths; a new invocation yields a distinct session/process ID; skill loading timing; learning-loop trigger and artifact latency (measured); Curator can be paused/isolated/snapshotted; session_search observability.
acceptance_criteria: Every required capability is reported verified, unsupported, or documented-fallback in docs/hermes-compatibility.md.
The MEMORY.md write mechanism is characterized (agent-direct vs Hermes-mediated) including whether a delimited YAML section survives a write round-trip.
One Curator strategy is recorded.
No public-doc assumption remains implicit.
tests/preflight.bats exists and encodes the required capability checks.

items.title: Enforce environment isolation
items.goal: Prove an automated run leaves real Hermes state unchanged.
items.scope: Sprint 1 task 1b only: isolation env and tests. BUILD-BLOCKING. If isolation cannot be achieved, STOP automating against Hermes and record the hand-script decision; do not implement later Hermes-touching tasks.
items.description: Assert that setting the isolation mechanism (HERMES_HOME override or existing scripts/start-wsl-isolated.sh) makes Hermes read/write a disposable directory, and that a marker file written to the real ~/.hermes is never touched by a test run. Every subsequent script and test sources the isolation env. If no override exists, tests run against a copied throwaway ~/.hermes; automation NEVER points at the real one.
acceptance_criteria: An automated run provably leaves real Hermes state unchanged.
Subsequent scripts/tests are documented to source the isolation env.
If isolation cannot be achieved, a recorded decision stops automation against Hermes (hand-script only).

manual_checks: Confirm isolation.bats would fail if a marker in real ~/.hermes were touched (read the test; do not run against the real profile).

items.title: Weakness schema and deterministic merge
items.goal: Ship a deterministic MEMORY.md weakness-block merge with schema, dedup, cap, and failure-safety tests passing.
items.scope: Sprint 1 task 2 only: harness-owned delimited block + atomic update. No fuzzy semantic merge. Do not implement demo sessions or candidate skills.
items.description: Strict TDD on deterministic shell logic: insert complete record; reject missing fields; merge same topic/family; dedup identical source_session_id+answer_ref; increment only on new observation; preserve first_seen, update last_seen; evict oldest on 4th topic; preserve unrelated MEMORY.md content; leave original intact on validation failure. Write into the delimited block form confirmed survivable in Task 1.
acceptance_criteria: All schema, merge, dedup, cap, eviction, preservation, and failure-safety tests pass.
Unrelated MEMORY.md content is preserved.
Validation failure leaves the original block intact.

items.title: Family-specific assessment contract
items.goal: Make family selection and persist decisions hold within the fixture-eval tolerance.
items.scope: Sprint 1 task 3 only: stable interviewer assessment contract and fixture eval. Do not implement session harness or MEMORY.md writes beyond proposing assessments.
items.description: Tolerance eval, not strict equality. Strong/weak fixtures per family; assert correct family selected; weakness proposed only when >=2 required elements missing; output names missing elements + concise evidence; technical answers not scored with STAR; one missing element does not persist. Run each case N times; require it to hold in the large majority, and flag flakiness rather than hard-failing a single off-run. Spec: N=5, pass if >=4 runs match persist decision.
acceptance_criteria: The fixture suite reliably (within tolerance) produces expected family, missing-element, and persist decisions.
Technical answers are not scored with STAR.
One missing element does not persist; >=2 missing elements does.

items.title: Gate: platform proof + deterministic core
items.goal: Confirm the platform contract is known, isolation is enforced, and core logic is testable.
items.scope: Verify-only Sprint 1 phase exit; do not implement features.
items.description: Sprint 1 exit: platform contract known, isolation enforced, core logic testable. Do not start session-one harness work in this item.
acceptance_criteria: docs/hermes-compatibility.md records verified/unsupported/fallback for required capabilities.
Isolation tests exist and claim real ~/.hermes is untouched.
Weakness merge and assessment fixture artifacts exist.

items.title: Three-question demo mode with deferred persistence
items.goal: Run session one end-to-end in the isolated profile with exactly three questions and deferred automatic persistence.
items.scope: Sprint 2 task 5 only: demo session one harness. Do not implement session two opener or candidate activation.
items.description: E2E against the isolated profile: exactly three questions; answers read from the scripted input file; assessments buffered; MEMORY.md unchanged before the third answer completes; session completion writes qualifying observations; no confirmation; concise output. Prefer Hermes-native session state if verified, else session-ID-scoped buffer under .crossfire/run/; commit only on explicit session-complete path. After the third answer the harness invokes /done (same finalize path as typing /done).
acceptance_criteria: E2E shows deferred automatic persistence.
Session one runs against installed Hermes in the isolated profile.
Exactly three questions; MEMORY.md unchanged until finalize after the third answer.
No persist confirmation prompt.

items.title: Create and stage the unverified candidate skill
items.goal: A poor answer produces a visible provenance-linked candidate SKILL.md that is not loadable before session two.
items.scope: Sprint 2 task 6 only: stage candidate outside the live skill dir and snapshot immediately. Do not load it for the opener.
items.description: Candidate created/patched after completion; status: unverified; contains weakness_id, source_session_id, answer_ref, observation_count; reuses one provenance key; lands outside the loaded skill dir; snapshotted immediately on creation before any Curator window; survives to the risk beat under the chosen Curator strategy. Prefer the verified learning-loop mechanism; if Hermes writes into the live dir, snapshot immediately then disable/move the live copy reversibly. Document whether the artifact is Hermes-authored, skill-authored, or harness-relocated.
acceptance_criteria: A poor answer produces a visible provenance-linked candidate SKILL.md.
A pre-session-two assertion proves it is not loadable.
If exclusion is impossible, the degraded path is recorded.

items.title: Fresh-process, memory-only opener
items.goal: Session two targets the persisted weakness with no naming prompt, no loaded candidate (or disclosed degraded path), and no pre-opener search.
items.scope: Sprint 2 task 7 only: session-two opener. This is the demo's minimum success bar. Do not implement the risk beat.
items.description: Integration: end process one; start process two with a different session ID; fail if any candidate skill is in the live dir (unless degraded path recorded); select newest weakness deterministically; print opening_target_source=MEMORY.md, weakness ID, source session before the question; ask a matching opener; detect and fail on any pre-opener session_search. Encode deterministic selection; add process/session evidence; instrument tool-call logging if supported, else structure the opener path so no archive-search action is available until selection returns.
acceptance_criteria: Automated and manual runs both show session two targeting the persisted weakness.
No naming prompt, no loaded candidate (or disclosed degraded path), no pre-opener search.
Distinct process and session IDs versus session one.
Opener prints opening_target_source, weakness_id, and source_session_id before the question.

manual_checks: Confirm the opener path prints opening_target_source before asking the question.

items.title: Gate: cross-session memory-only opener
items.goal: Confirm the deliverable demo: memory-only opener works across separate processes with candidate exclusion (or recorded degraded path).
items.scope: Verify-only Sprint 2 phase exit; do not implement the risk beat or timed demo assembly.
items.description: This is the deliverable demo gate. Do not start the risk beat until this passes.
acceptance_criteria: Session two targets the weak area with no operator prompt that names it.
Candidate skill is not in the live dir at opener (or degraded path is recorded).
Session one and two are different processes and session IDs.
Tests never mutate real ~/.hermes.

items.title: Question bank
items.goal: Add a statically validated broader question bank without inventing employer facts.
items.scope: Sprint 3 slot for plan Task 4. CUT FIRST under time pressure. Do not change the three never-cut demo questions.
items.description: Static validation: covers McCain/Mastercard/Praetor/ALTER_EGO and all three families; every question has stable ID + declared family; demo questions concise; no invented employer facts. Three demo questions live in session-one fixtures and are never cut.
acceptance_criteria: Static tests pass.
Three demo questions remain complete within the measured session-one budget.
No invented employer facts.

items.title: Artifact evidence and bounded waits
items.goal: A reviewer sees durable artifacts without filesystem navigation, with bounded timeouts.
items.scope: Sprint 3 task 8 only: evidence display helpers. Cut after T4/T11/T9 if time-constrained; never wait indefinitely.
items.description: Before-snapshot of MEMORY.md; print only the relevant diff after completion; print candidate skill + metadata; time out with nonzero status and useful message when an artifact is missing; never wait indefinitely.
acceptance_criteria: Success and timeout paths pass.
A reviewer sees the durable artifacts without filesystem navigation.

items.title: Labeled unverified-learning risk beat
items.goal: Show the generated skill shaping a later turn without contaminating opener attribution.
items.scope: Sprint 3 task 9 only. Cut if time-constrained; the opener demo stands alone. Do not start this until S2-GE would pass.
items.description: Activation cannot occur before the opener completes; UNVERIFIED LEARNING RISK DEMO label + warning appear before candidate influence; candidate installs to a namespaced live path; new process started if loading is startup-only; active candidate keeps unverified metadata; candidate available in a later session unless cleaned up.
acceptance_criteria: The beat visibly uses the generated skill.
It cannot contaminate opener attribution.
It truthfully presents unverified status.

items.title: Assemble and time the ~90-second demo
items.goal: Compose a full-sequence smoke that completes within 90 seconds after pre-warm.
items.scope: Sprint 3 task 10 only: compose existing scripts. Do not duplicate session logic. If measured time exceeds 90s, drop one extra question-bank item before touching process separation or attribution — never drop the three demo questions.
items.description: Full-sequence smoke: preflight passes; session one, restart, memory-only opener, evidence display, risk beat all complete; distinct IDs + layer labels appear; total <=90s after pre-warm; any failure exits early with a recovery instruction. Scripted bad answer unambiguously missing >=2 elements. Narrow, explicit reset/prep command that never deletes unrelated Hermes state.
acceptance_criteria: Three consecutive rehearsals complete within 90s and produce the expected evidence and opener.
Failure exits early with a recovery instruction.
Reset/prep never deletes unrelated Hermes state.

manual_checks: Timed rehearsal evidence is recorded if the e2e test cannot enforce wall-clock 90s.

items.title: Gate: evidence + risk beat
items.goal: Confirm the audience sees what was learned, which layer caused each behavior, and why ungated learning is dangerous.
items.scope: Verify-only Sprint 3 phase exit. Cuttable with the sprint. Task 4 is not required to pass this gate.
items.description: Sprint 3 exit. Do not implement Monday free-form or the final acceptance checklist here.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence display and risk beat artifacts exist.
Demo script documents layer labels and the unverified-learning warning.

items.title: Free-form Monday usability
items.goal: Record a manual free-form run that is useful without editing prompts or files.
items.scope: Sprint 4 task 11 only. Cut second under time pressure. Do not auto-copy stage-demo weaknesses into real ~/.hermes.
items.description: Non-demo run: agent continues beyond three questions; sensible no-weakness behavior; targets an existing weakness without demo-only chatter; optional session_search only after the opener and degrades gracefully; exit still flushes buffered qualifying observations.
acceptance_criteria: A manual free-form run is recorded.
The tool is useful without editing prompts or files.
Demo weaknesses do not auto-copy into the Monday profile.

manual_checks: A recorded free-form run exists in tests/interactive_smoke.md.

items.title: Final safety and acceptance pass
items.goal: Record demo-blocking acceptance evidence and known limitations for anything cut.
items.scope: Sprint 4 task 12: full suite in the isolated profile plus a read-only audit. Do not point checks at real ~/.hermes. Optional sprint items are logged as known limitations if cut, not treated as blockers.
items.description: Full suite in the isolated profile, then a read-only audit: real MEMORY.md has no malformed/duplicate section; candidate and stable skill namespaces cannot collide; no fixture leaked into live Hermes state; Curator handling matches the compatibility note; every demo-blocking acceptance criterion has recorded evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Demo-blocking tests pass.
The checklist is complete.
The demo runs from a clean terminal without undocumented manual steps.
Should-pass items are logged as known limitations if cut.

items.title: Gate: final acceptance
items.goal: Confirm demo-blocking acceptance criteria have recorded evidence and the demo is operable from a clean terminal.
items.scope: Verify-only final plan gate. Cuttable sprint-4 polish must not be inferred as required if logged as known limitations.
items.description: Final gate. Gate model is cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast; never Opus.
acceptance_criteria: docs/acceptance-checklist.md exists and covers demo-blocking criteria.
Isolation and two-process opener evidence still exist.
